details:
Thank you very much for your continued efforts in the development and operation of VRChat.

Currently, defining or accessing an array of `HumanBodyBones` in Udon results in compilation errors.

Here are some examples:

**1. When defining an array:**

```

var boneArray = new HumanBodyBones[] { HumanBodyBones.Head, HumanBodyBones.Chest };

```

Error:

```

[UdonSharp] Assets/HumanBodyBonesArrayTest.cs(8,63): Method is not exposed to Udon: 'new HumanBodyBones[] { HumanBodyBones.Head, HumanBodyBones.Chest }'

```

**2. When accessing a field array by index:**

```

Debug.Log(_boneArray[0]);

```

Error:

```

[UdonSharp] Assets/HumanBodyBonesArrayTest.cs(10,24): Method is not exposed to Udon: '_boneArray[0]'

```

The `HumanBodyBones` enum is essential for handling avatar skeleton structures.

If arrays of `HumanBodyBones` could be used in Udon, it would greatly simplify and optimize implementations such as character control, bone following, and IK systems.

This would improve both code clarity and runtime efficiency.

I am aware that a similar request was posted three years ago ([HumanBodyBones Array Support](https://feedback.vrchat.com/udon/p/humanbodybones-array-support)), but that post does not contain any details or examples.

For that reason, I have written this new post to provide a more thorough explanation of the issue.

Whether to merge this post with the existing one is, of course, entirely up to the VRChat team’s discretion.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration.
title: Please allow the use of HumanBodyBones arrays in Udon.
